title: Head of Growth, Brand & Product Marketing - Mobile Dating App
description:
**About Us**

We are an early-stage startup preparing to launch a mobile dating app competing in the same market as Tinder, Bumble and Hinge.

Our working culture is fast-moving, hands-on and shaped by short decision cycles, evolving priorities and limited resources. We need someone who enjoys this environment, takes initiative and remains composed and effective when deadlines are tight or plans change.

You will help shape the product, build the brand and bring the app to market. Initially, you will personally deliver much of the work across marketing, content, partnerships and automation. As the business develops, the role may expand to include building and leading a team.

**Job Description**

You will play a central role in deciding how the app is positioned, how the brand looks and communicates, which audiences we serve and how the product develops to meet their needs.

Working closely with the founding and development teams, you will turn market research, user insights and performance data into recommendations for product priorities, features, onboarding and the overall user experience. Your involvement starts before launch and continues through ongoing product development and growth.

You will also own the marketing strategy and its practical execution. This includes creating the content and systems needed across websites, social media, YouTube long-form videos, Shorts, advertising, influencer campaigns and partnerships.

Exceptional practical expertise in AI is essential. You must be able to use AI to produce high-quality work independently and build reliable content pipelines and automations. n8n and similar tools should be part of your everyday workflow.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Shape the product:** Research user needs, competitors and market opportunities. Help define the product's value proposition, contribute to roadmap priorities and turn insights into clear feature proposals and briefs.
* **Improve the user experience:** Work with the product and development teams on onboarding, activation, engagement, retention and monetization. Help define experiments and assess whether changes improve the experience.
* **Build the brand:** Develop brand positioning, messaging, tone of voice, visual direction and storytelling. Translate these into a consistent identity across the app and all marketing channels.
* **Own go-to-market:** Develop and execute the pre-launch, launch and growth strategy, including target audiences, market selection, channel priorities and campaign planning.
* **Create marketing content:** Personally plan, produce, edit and publish the content the business needs, including websites, landing pages, social posts, advertising assets, graphics, email campaigns, YouTube long-form videos, Shorts and other short-form video.
* **Build content pipelines:** Use AI and automation to support research, scripting, visual production, video editing, repurposing, publishing and performance analysis while maintaining creative quality.
* **Develop influencer marketing:** Identify suitable creators, establish relationships, negotiate collaborations, develop campaign briefs and measure results.
* **Establish partnerships:** Find and develop relevant brand, community, event and distribution partnerships that support awareness, trust and user acquisition.
* **Drive measurable growth:** Run acquisition and lifecycle experiments across paid, organic, referral and community channels. Connect marketing activity to activation, retention and commercial outcomes.
* **Automate operations:** Build and maintain n8n workflows and integrations that reduce repetitive work across marketing, content production, partnerships and reporting.
* **Support future team growth:** As needs and resources develop, help identify hiring priorities, document effective workflows and onboard colleagues or external specialists.

**Required Qualifications**

  

* Substantial hands-on experience launching and growing consumer mobile apps, with a demonstrable personal contribution to apps reaching six-, seven- or eight-figure download totals.
* Evidence of your own impact: the decisions you owned, the work you delivered and the measurable results achieved.
* Experience contributing directly to product development through user research, feature definition, prioritization, experimentation and collaboration with designers and developers.
* Strong brand-building ability, including positioning, messaging, visual judgment and consistent execution across product and marketing.
* Exceptional practical AI skills across research, writing, design, image generation, video production, editing and content workflows.
* The ability to independently produce marketing content across multiple formats, including social media, YouTube long-form videos, Shorts, websites and advertising creatives.
* Hands-on experience with influencer marketing, creator collaborations and partnership development.
* Strong practical knowledge of n8n or comparable automation platforms, including APIs, webhooks, integrations and reliable workflow operation.
* A solid understanding of mobile acquisition, attribution, activation, retention, customer acquisition cost and lifetime value.
* The judgment to prioritize the channels and activities that matter most, balancing quality, speed and limited startup resources.
* A willingness to take ownership across disciplines and personally execute the work required at an early-stage business.
* Resilience under pressure, strong prioritization skills and the ability to maintain quality and sound judgment during demanding launch phases.
* Comfort working with uncertainty, changing priorities and limited startup resources, with the confidence to communicate trade-offs, flag constraints early and propose practical solutions.

**Especially Valuable Experience**

  

* Experience with dating apps, social discovery products or consumer platforms that depend on network effects.
* Growing mobile apps to millions or tens of millions of downloads.
* Taking a product from pre-launch through launch and subsequent growth.
* Building local user density, communities and market-by-market launch strategies.
* Developing a brand from the beginning and carrying it consistently into the product experience.
* Building a YouTube presence, repeatable video formats or creator-led acquisition channels.
* Establishing partnerships that delivered measurable distribution, engagement or revenue.
* Growing from an individual contributor into a team leadership role within a startup.

**What We Offer**

  

* A central role in shaping the product, brand and market launch of a new mobile dating app.
* Broad responsibility across creative work, product decisions, marketing and growth.
* The opportunity to build practical systems and workflows from the beginning.
* The potential to help build and lead a team as the business grows.

**How to Apply**

Please share your CV and selected examples demonstrating:

* Mobile apps you helped launch or scale, their download totals and your personal contribution.
* Product decisions or improvements you helped shape, including the user insight behind them and the outcome.
* Branding and marketing content you personally created, ideally covering multiple formats.
* AI-powered content workflows or automations you built.
* Influencer campaigns or partnerships you developed and the results they produced.

Public links and anonymized examples are welcome. Please respect the confidentiality of previous employers and clients.

title: Mobile App Developer Intern
description:
**Job Overview**

Parashift Technologies is looking for a motivated Mobile App Developer Intern to develop and customize a white-labelled mobile application for iOS and Android using Ionic and Angular. The application will integrate with our existing web platform and include features such as user authentication, in-app purchases, payment integration, push notifications, and account management.

**A) Key Responsibilities**

* Set up the development environment, including Node.js, Ionic CLI, Android Studio, and Xcode, and build the existing application from source.
* Understand the application's codebase, including Angular modules, services, and plugins, and integrate it with our existing web platform, including login and Single Sign-On (SSO).
* Customize the application branding, including app ID / bundle ID, app name, theme (SCSS), logo, icons, splash screen, and language strings.
* Configure push notifications using Firebase Cloud Messaging (Android), Apple Push Notification service (APNs), and AirNotifier where applicable.
* Develop an in-app catalogue featuring item listings, detail pages, pricing, purchase options, and user registration.
* Integrate payment solutions, including Apple In-App Purchases and Google Play Billing, with Razorpay on Android where permitted by applicable store policies.
* Implement purchase receipt verification and automated access provisioning through the backend.
* Collaborate with the PHP development team to configure backend web services, authentication, application settings, and a custom PHP plugin for payment verification and access management.
* Work with Moodle web services and mobile application settings where required for backend integration.
* Test the application on real Android and iOS devices, including sandbox purchase testing on both platforms.
* Prepare release builds, configure signing, set up in-app purchase products, prepare store listings, and submit applications to the Apple App Store and Google Play Store.
* Address app review feedback, resolve technical issues, and support application launch.
* Monitor crash reports, troubleshoot production issues, and deliver post-release updates and hotfixes.

**B) Key Requirements & Qualifications**

**1. Mobile Frontend Development**

* Ionic 8, Angular 20, TypeScript 5, RxJS, and SCSS.
* Apache Cordova, including cordova-android, cordova-ios, and Awesome Cordova Plugins.
* Experience with libraries such as:
* ngx-translate (internationalization)SwiperChart.jsDay.jsMathJaxVideo.js
* Development tools: Node.js 24, npm, Angular CLI, Ionic CLI, Gulp, Webpack, ESLint, and Jest.
* Familiarity with native mobile capabilities and plugins, including:

Advanced HTTP requestsIn-app browserFile handling and file transferCamera and media captureQR code scanningPush notificationsSQLite storage and offline data management

**2. Backend Integration**

* Familiarity with PHP 8.x and MySQL / MariaDB or PostgreSQL.
* Experience integrating mobile applications with REST APIs and token-based authentication.
* Understanding of backend services, payment verification, and automated access provisioning.
* Ability to collaborate with backend developers to implement custom PHP plugins and API integrations.
* Familiarity with Moodle web services, mobile application services, and related settings where required.

**3. Third-Party Services and Tools**

* Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) and Apple Push Notification service (APNs).
* Apple Developer Program, App Store Connect, and Google Play Console.
* Android Studio, Xcode (macOS), Git, and GitHub.
* Apple In-App Purchases (StoreKit) and Google Play Billing.
* Razorpay integration where permitted by platform policies.

**C) Good to Have**

* Basic knowledge of PHP and MySQL.
* Familiarity with Moodle web services and plugin development.
* Experience writing unit tests using Jest.
* Experience publishing an application on the Google Play Store or Apple App Store.

Pay: ₹5,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: D&T Manager – Sites & Services
description:
**COMPANY OVERVIEW**

We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.

  
  

**OVERVIEW**

This senior role is a strategic engineering leader within the BTFE team, responsible for architecting, building, and overseeing scalable, secure, and maintainable digital products and services. The individual will lead delivery across the predominantly .NET-based BTFE technology ecosystem, while governing mobile application delivery through vendor partners and strengthening the team’s future cross-platform engineering capabilities.

With advanced expertise across multiple technologies, they will guide full lifecycle development—from technical planning and design to implementation, deployment, and ongoing optimization. They will mentor developers, lead design discussions, manage technical risks and debt, and collaborate cross-functionally to align solutions with business objectives. The role also includes ownership of production stability, vendor engineering quality, troubleshooting, performance tuning, security, and sustained technical excellence across web, API, backend, and mobile-integrated platforms.

  

**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES**

**Delivery Leadership & Execution**

* Leading delivery of complex BTFE products, platforms, and modules across internal teams and vendor partners with end-to-end accountability for scope, quality, release readiness, and delivery outcomes

* Owning production support strategy across BTFE platforms, including incident management, root cause analysis, problem management, service reliability, and continuous improvement for critical issues

* Driving stakeholder alignment through active participation in product discovery, requirement gathering, scope definition, technical planning, dependency management, and release planning

* Providing high-confidence estimates for large-scale efforts, advising on resourcing and partner capacity, and establishing delivery plans that balance near-term outcomes with long-term technical health

**Learning, Development & Mentoring**

* Championing a culture of continuous learning, introducing relevant emerging technologies, cross-platform frameworks, engineering practices, and AI-enabled ways of working

* Providing deep mentorship and technical guidance to mid- and junior-level engineers, while building capability across .NET, web/API, cloud, integration, and mobile engineering fundamentals

* Leading internal initiatives such as architecture reviews, engineering talks, vendor knowledge exchanges, and capability development programs

* Demonstrating strong leadership presence, strengthening team culture and practices, and creating an environment where people can do their best work and grow

**Technical Consulting & Strategy**

* Creating and validating high-level estimations, technology roadmaps, modernization plans, and investment cases for large, cross-functional BTFE efforts

* Designing and owning complex, scalable, secure, and resilient end-to-end solutions across .NET, APIs, cloud services, data stores, third-party integrations, and mobile experiences

Serving as an advisor across BTFE product, business, operations, security, architecture, and vendor communities, aligning solutions with strategic goals and user needs.  

  

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* Independently defines and manages work plans for complex projects, driving alignment across teams and contributing to strategic project planning

* Has led multiple medium-to-large projects or delivered key enterprise-level components with full accountability for scope, quality, delivery outcomes, and production readiness

* Shapes and enforces IT technical standards, driving adoption of best practices and fostering engineering excellence across teams, vendors, and initiatives

* Possesses expert-level knowledge of enterprise architecture, system design patterns, distributed systems, and technical toolsets, applying them to architect resilient, scalable solutions

* Advanced experience with .NET Core, C#, ASP.NET Core/Web API, API integration, relational and NoSQL databases, cloud platforms, CI/CD, automated testing, observability, and production support

Credible cross-platform development experience with exposure to mobile application engineering, including mobile architecture, API integration, security, performance, telemetry, release lifecycle, and app-store delivery; hands-on experience with React Native, Flutter, Xamarin, .NET MAUI, or equivalent is expected.  

  

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

Demonstrates the General Mills leadership behaviors required for success: energizes and inspires others; grows by deepening and sharing expertise; challenges with strategic courage; delivers impactful results across teams; and connects and aligns cross-functional efforts

* Experience with .NET MAUI, React Native, Flutter, Xamarin, or comparable cross-platform frameworks, with working knowledge of native iOS and/or Android engineering ecosystems

* Energizes and inspires others

* Grows by deepening and sharing expertise

* Challenges with strategic courage

* Delivers impactful results across teams

* Connects and aligns cross-functional efforts

  

**ELIGIBILITY**

Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

title: iOS Lead (6-Month Contract)
description:

We take as much pride in our people, culture and work-life balance as we do in making better software. We’re not just making better software. We’re making the making of software better. * Engage directly with the customer
* Drive native iOS development on a complex publishing project
* Work with other teams contributing to the same codebase
* Use AI-assisted development tools and encourage the team to use them
* Take a proactive approach to delivery and to supporting the team

* Strong hands-on experience in native iOS development
* Proven experience as a tech lead, leading and guiding a team
* Experience working with customers

* Hands-on use of AI and agents
* Proactive and able to take ownership

We are happy to cater to your needs to make the interview accessible, if this is something you require please let us know by emailing us at* *join@clearroute.io*

title: Senior Android Developer
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


The Digital S/W Engineer Analyst SDE \- Mobile Development is a Technology/ Engineering role involving both development and Testing. As a member of the SCRUM team, you will be
  

delivering Customer facing Banking and/or Credit Card features on digital channels such as Browser and Mobile. You will be involved in all stages of the Agile SDLC cycle. It includes but not
  

limited to (a) Requirement analysis: Grooming of user stories, Story pointing, decomposing big stories into smaller stories and define acceptance criteria. (b) Design Review: Reviewing
  

screens, flows, features, and customer communications (emails, SMS’s, notifications, PDF documents) and making sure that they are consistent with user story acceptance criteria
  

(c) Software development: Developing, configuring and debugging applications comprising of mobile frontend and Micro services. (d) Validations: Creating automated and manual test scripts
  

on BDD (Behavior Based Development) framework, executing test scripts. Identifying, triaging and fixing any defects. Conditioning and maintaining the test data. (e) Artifact
  

Ownership: Creating and maintaining testing artifacts such as Test plans and Exit reports and maintaining traceability as per SDLC guidelines. Maintaining SDLC hygiene involving stories.
  

Test cases and defects. Ensuring that no untested code goes out to production. (f) SDLC Process and Standards: Adhering to ADA (Americans with Disability Act) Guidelines, participating in
  

retrospectives, process improvement workshops, audits and performing root cause analysis. (g) Postproduction support: Supporting the technical check outs during release go live and
  

postproduction activities.


Responsibilities


* Translate application designs into code across Android/Jetpack/Kotlin development platforms as Primary Skill, with guidance from senior developers.
* Deep understanding of the **Android SDK**, platform lifecycle, and Google ecosystem (Jetpack, Android Runtime, etc.)
* Leverage AI tools such as GitHub Copilot to assist with code generation, refactoring, and debugging tasks.
* Contribute to the development and maintenance of BDD (Behavior Driven Development) automated and manual test scripts in a code repository; execute scripts and record results in a test management tool.
* Use AI\-assisted tools to help accelerate unit test creation, API scaffolding, Angular components, and Spring Boot boilerplate code.
* Participate in the software development lifecycle including development, integration, and E2E testing within a CI/CD environment (e.g., RTC, Jenkins).
* Write secure, stable, testable, and maintainable code under the guidance of senior engineers, and take accountability for assigned features.
* Build and maintain documentation for your features and begin developing subject matter expertise in specific areas of the application.
* Assist in analyzing root causes for application issues and performance concerns; collaborate within the scrum team to triage and report defects.
* Learn and adhere to SDLC control processes and contribute ideas for continuous improvement.
* Perform functional validations to meet acceptance criteria; gain familiarity with Responsive Web Design validation and ADA Accessibility testing tools (e.g., NVDA, Voiceover, Talkback, Axe).
* Participate in team meetings and contribute to tracking progress against team objectives.
* Work effectively in a fast\-paced environment involving onshore and offshore teams.

Education, Qualification \& Certifications


* Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering or a related STEM field, or comparable work experience.
* 4\- 7 years of experience in full\-stack mobile development and/or testing in a professional environment.
* Basic familiarity with Behavior\-Driven Development (BDD) concepts; exposure to test automation frameworks such as Selenium with Cucumber is a plus.
* Exposure to or interest in cloud\-based development platforms such as OpenShift is desirable but not required.
* Basic working knowledge of collaboration and project management tools such as JIRA, Confluence, SharePoint, Microsoft Teams, and Microsoft Office Suite.
* Eagerness to learn, self\-motivated, and willing to take ownership of assigned tasks.
* Good written and oral communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively within a team.
